instruction: You are a strategic corporate innovation advisor. Analyse the company profile and survey responses, then respond ONLY with a valid JSON object containing maturity_score, opportunities, next_steps, and key_weaknesses.

answers.companyDescription: Core Technologies is a micro-scale life insurance and retirement savings provider managing approximately €800M in mathematical provisions. The company primarily offers traditional with-profits and unit-linked products through established bancassurance partnerships, while actively exploring digital onboarding solutions and needs-analysis tools for retail bank advisors.
answers.pastInitiatives: We operate an internal venture studio model where cross-functional teams pitch innovation ideas to an investment committee quarterly. Approved projects receive 6 months of funded incubation with dedicated resources, having successfully graduated one project into a separate business unit focused on micro-pension schemes.
answers.strategicGoals: The board has mandated that 25% of revenue should come from products or services that did not exist three years ago. This requires us to systematically explore adjacent markets, new customer segments, and alternative monetization models, prioritizing strategic acquisitions over purely organic growth.
answers.additionalContext: The company relies heavily on complex regulatory compliance, which limits rapid scaling but provides a moat against larger competitors. Operational costs are tightly controlled due to the micro-size and limited working capital.
answers.teamSize: The founder handles all product and technology decisions personally with occasional input from a part-time freelance developer. There is no formal engineering team — technical work is either done by the founder or outsourced to contractors on a project basis. Innovation bandwidth is essentially limited to whatever the founder can personally drive alongside day-to-day operations.

opportunities.title: Operational Efficiency Optimization via AI Chatbots
opportunities.rationale: Implementing generative AI for handling routine customer inquiries and compliance document summarization can immediately reduce operational costs and improve the efficiency of the existing bancassurance channels.

first_actions: Identify 3 high-volume support queries for pilot bot training.
Allocate $15k from budget for a low-code chatbot implementation sprint.
Conduct regulatory compliance review with legal team to ensure alignment with applicable regulations
execution_plan.success_metric: Reduce customer service handling time by 15% within Q3.
milestones: Pilot launch in one bank partnership (Month 4)

opportunities.title: Direct Digital Wealth Management Platform Launch
opportunities.rationale: Developing a proprietary, fully digital wealth management tool that bypasses traditional high-cost distribution channels allows the company to capture new, digitally native segments and create a true diversification platform.

first_actions: Form a dedicated 'Digital Future' task force.
Conduct feasibility study on regulatory framework for direct-to-consumer sales.
resources_needed: $100,000 seed funding request (external or internal reallocation)
Hire one full-time product manager with FinTech experience
execution_plan.success_metric: Achieve 5% of total new revenue from direct digital channels within 3 years.

opportunities.title: Acquisition of Niche InsurTech Startup
opportunities.rationale: Acquiring a small, innovative insurtech firm focused on cyber risk insurance or specialized retirement products provides immediate market diversification and access to new customer niches without the time commitment of organic development.

first_actions: Develop a target list of 5 companies in adjacent sectors.
Establish valuation benchmarks and legal due diligence process.
execution_plan.success_metric: Successful integration and revenue contribution from acquired entity within 18 months.

next_steps.action: Finalize and fund the feasibility study for the Direct Digital Wealth Management Platform.
Initiate due diligence on target InsurTech acquisition candidates to explore diversification platforms.

key_weaknesses: Lack of dedicated, in-house engineering talent leading to reliance on founder bandwidth.
High regulatory burden creating significant time constraints for innovation and product iteration.
Formal innovation process is constrained by the 'owner_alone' decision-making structure, potentially stifling cross-departmental radical ideas.
Limited working capital (8% budget) makes high-cost, large-scale radical projects financially risky.
